Done. `/app/polyglot/main.rs` compiles cleanly as both Rust and C++ and produces identical output for all tested N (0–93, wrapping mod 2⁶⁴ on overflow).

How it works:
- `/*/*/` — closes immediately for C++ (C comments don't nest), but leaves Rust at comment depth 2, hiding the C++ code.
- `// */ */ //\` — the two `*/` bring Rust back to depth 0; the trailing `\` splices the next line into the `//` comment for C++.
- Every Rust line ends with `//\`, so C++ sees the entire Rust block as one continued `//` comment.
